name: Kenesis — AR Gesture Controlled Robot
shortDescription: Modular robot controlled through Snap Spectacles AR — finger gestures move and grab objects in the physical world with sub-100ms latency. Built at Hack the North 2025.
description:
Built a modular robot platform controlled through Snap Spectacles, enabling natural gesture-based navigation and robotic-arm manipulation. Teleoperation feels as natural as moving your own hands.

Highlights:
- Developed an end-to-end gesture-to-motion pipeline: Snap API → Flask server → HiveMQ MQTT → ROS2 nodes.
- Implemented on NVIDIA Jetson Nano, handling motor drivers, camera streaming, and AI inference fully on-device.
- Created a Lens Studio AR application for gesture recognition and live camera streaming back to the AR glasses.
- Designed a mobile 2-wheel drive base with modular chassis attachments, including a 3DoF robotic arm.
- Optimized the system for sub-100ms latency and introduced an MQTT communication layer that scales to multi-robot scenarios.

Submitted as 'Kenesis' at Hack the North 2025.
